en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a slightly curving town street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. People walk along the street, including a woman pushing a baby carriage. In the distance stands a large church with a steep roof and twin towers. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location, and small publisher information appears in the lower left corner.
